draft.title: Effects of the Industrial Revolution
card: Factories needed many workers. People left farms and villages for the towns, so cities such as Manchester grew very fast.
Cities were crowded and often dirty. Many families shared small homes with poor drains and little clean water, and diseases such as cholera spread easily.
Factory work meant long hours, low pay and dangerous machines. Children were employed too, because they were cheap to hire and small enough to reach between machinery.

These conditions led to change. Parliament passed laws on working conditions, such as limits on child labour, and workers joined trade unions, which are groups that act together to win better pay and safer work.
draft.remember: Factories brought crowded cities and harsh work, and the response was new laws and trade unions.

a.q: Why did workers form trade unions in industrial Britain?
opts: To act together for better pay and safer work
To stop factories from using any machines
To move families from the cities back to farms
To make laws on working conditions themselves
a.why: Unions let workers act as a group, which gave them more power than asking for change alone. Laws were passed by Parliament, not by unions, so the last option is tempting but wrong.
a.clue: Think about what a group of workers can do that one worker cannot.

b.q: In 1800 a village girl named Ellen moves to a factory town to find work. Which is most likely to have been true of her new life?
opts: She lived in a crowded home with a risk of disease
She worked short hours with a high wage
She was protected by laws limiting child labour
She had cleaner water than in her village
b.why: Industrial towns grew fast and were crowded, with poor drains and little clean water, so disease spread easily. Laws limiting child labour came later, in response to these conditions, so they would not have protected her in 1800.
b.clue: Think about what cities were like when they grew so quickly, before any reforms.

a.best: To act together for better pay and safer work

b.best: She lived in a crowded home with a risk of disease
